verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Logseq Sync spans Desktop, Android and iOS (up to 10 graphs, end-to-end encrypted) and a logseq:// protocol for quick capture from mobile/browser, implying mobile apps exist and can capture/sync into the same graph. However, there is no direct evidence describing mobile-specific search, linking, or full editing feature parity versus desktop, and community threads report sync as buggy/clunky, raising doubts about a seamless whole-knowledge-base experience on mobile. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on reports of full search and page/block linking UI on the iOS/Android apps, and confirmation that mobile apps are not stripped-down relative to desktop.
